sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 16:62

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 16:62:1
items.html:
The place of these fourteen Sefirot was then the boundary of the worlds etc., a Shabbat boundary around it. He alludes here to the secret of the Shabbat boundary of two thousand cubits, which is given and added to the measure of the city, and where it is permitted to go out of the city.
And the matter is that Shabbat is the secret of the dominion of Atzilut in all the worlds, for there the three worlds BYA rise to Atzilut, as the ARI writes below. And this is the secret of the verse, “Let no man go out of his place on the day of Shabbat.” For the city in which one dwells on Shabbat alludes to the place of the world of Atzilut, where the worlds rose; therefore one is forbidden to go out of his city on the day of Shabbat, just as the worlds do not go out of Atzilut on the day of Shabbat. And even so, our sages added another two thousand cubits around the city, where it is permitted to go out of the city, and one does not thereby transgress “no man shall go out of his place on the day of Shabbat.” And this requires a reason: why is this not regarded as going outside his place?
And this is what the ARI says, that the two thousand cubits around the city correspond to these sixteen Sefirot, which are the ten Sefirot of Beria and the six Sefirot of Yetzira down to the Chazeh [chest], where the worlds ended at the time of their emergence, before the sin of Adam HaRishon. As he writes, “When they reached the place of the sixth Sefira, the Sium [end] of the present Yetzira, He said to them, Enough, and do not expand and do not enter into the boundary of the fourteen Sefirot,” which are the four lower ones of the present Yetzira and the ten Sefirot of the present Assiya.
And these words need to be understood: since on Shabbat all the worlds rise to Atzilut, and those sixteen Sefirot down to the Chazeh of the present Yetzira also remain empty of the light of holiness, it follows that the Shabbat boundary was made above, at the place of the Parsa between Atzilut and Beria, that is, at the place where Atzilut ended. So why is it permitted to go out, and it is not regarded as going outside the boundary, as far as the place of the Chazeh of Yetzira?
To understand this, we need to remember everything the ARI wrote above in this part, from item 1 to item 8, and in the Inner Light there, that is, in the explanation of the place of BYA. For all these thirty Sefirot of BYA, the sixteen and the fourteen with which the ARI deals here, revolve chiefly around the thirty Sefirot of the place of BYA, which are called the externality of the three worlds BYA, which have no ascent even on the day of Shabbat, as the ARI writes below. And about them he says that at the Sium of the sixteenth Sefira is the Shabbat boundary, and it is forbidden to enter into the boundary of the fourteen Sefirot below. Now, it was explained there that this place of BYA was made of the Partzuf of half of Tifferet and the NHY of AK, which remained beneath the Parsa of Atzilut at the time of the second restriction. This was because of the ascent of the coupling Malchut to the Nikvey Einayim, while the concluding Malchut rose to the place of half of Tifferet, which is the Bina of the Guf [body], and there the place of the Sium of the line of Ein Sof was made, which is the secret of the Parsa of Atzilut, from which downward there remained a vacant and empty space, without light. Therefore half of Tifferet and the NHY of AK remained empty, without light, and they are called the place of the three worlds BYA, meaning that within them the three worlds BYA were destined to expand. See there in the Inner Light the whole continuation: from the lower half of Tifferet a place was made for the world of Beria, from NHY a place was made for the world of Yetzira, and from Malchut a place was made for the world of Assiya.
And it is known what the ARI laid down for us as a rule: that you have no small spark in all four worlds ABYA that does not have in it, relative to itself, the four phases of ABYA. It follows that in those TNHY of the Partzuf Nekudot of SAG of AK, which remained beneath the Parsa of Atzilut as the place of BYA, they too are discerned, in themselves, as four phases: ABYA. For those TNHYM themselves expand into ten Sefirot, HBD HGT NHYM, where HBD is the Rosh [head], and HGT down to the Chazeh is the discernment of Atzilut in it, and from the Chazeh to the Sium of Tifferet, the Beria in it, and NHY are Yetzira, and Malchut is the Assiya in it. Thus the main force of the dominion of BYA in it is not revealed except from the Chazeh downward, that is, from the Sium of the sixth Sefira of Yetzira downward; but from the Chazeh upward it is still the discernment of Atzilut in the values of the vessels, although it is empty of upper light on account of the Parsa of Atzilut above it, which has already ended the line of Ein Sof there.
Thus the great difference between the sixteen Sefirot from the Chazeh upward in the place of BYA and the fourteen Sefirot from the Chazeh downward in it has been well explained, even at the time when it is all empty of light, that is, immediately after the second restriction: for even then it is discerned that down to the Chazeh the discernment of BYA is not apparent in the vessels, since they are the discernment of Rosh and Atzilut in the vessels, and only from the Chazeh downward is the force of BYA apparent in them.
With this, the matter of the two thousand cubits of the Shabbat boundary is well understood, that it is permitted to go out within them although they are outside the city, for the ARI says that they correspond to these sixteen Sefirot from the Chazeh upward of BYA. For although, from the discernment of the light in them, they are already BYA, since they are found below the Parsa of Atzilut, and are therefore regarded as being outside the city, nevertheless, since from the discernment of the vessels they are still Atzilut down to the sixth Sefira of Yetzira, it is therefore still permitted to walk there, for it is not regarded as going out of Atzilut to the outside, since they are still the discernment of Atzilut on the side of the vessels. Therefore the prohibition of “let no man go out of his place” does not apply to them, for from the discernment of the place, that is, on the side of the vessels, they are still Atzilut, as explained.
And the matter of the number of two thousand cubits alludes to the two Sefirot Keter and Hochma in them, for HBD is Rosh and Keter, and HGT is Atzilut and Hochma, since the five Sefirot KHB ZON are the ones called Rosh and ABYA, as is known. It follows that down to the Chazeh of Yetzira they are only two Sefirot, Keter and Hochma, and from the Chazeh downward they are Bina and ZON. And this is what the ARI says, that they are called the Shabbat boundary, for Shabbat is the discernment of Atzilut, and at the Sium of the sixth Sefira of Yetzira is the boundary of Atzilut, and from there downward the BYA in them begins, which are the fourteen lower Sefirot.
And let it not be difficult for you, what the ARI wrote nearby, that the Rosh is Beria, HGT down to the Chazeh is Yetzira, and from the Chazeh downward is Assiya. For the values of the lights are one thing and the values of the vessels another; and what the ARI laid down for us as a rule in several places, that you have no small spark in all of ABYA that does not have in itself the discernment of ABYA, these are the values of the vessels. Even the corporeal body is discerned as having Keter and ABYA in it: its Rosh is the discernment of Keter, from the Peh [mouth] to the Chazeh is Atzilut, from the Chazeh to the Tabur is Beria, and from the Tabur downward, Yetzira and Assiya, as is known; although, in the value of the lights, it does not have in it even the light of Malchut before it attains the ten Sefirot of Assiya, which are called Ofanim, as is known. Likewise, even a fetus in its mother’s womb already has these ten Sefirot in it, and no vessel will be added to it when it grows; it is only that the vessels are not fit for their function before they attain the lights ascribed to them, and this is why we usually name the vessels after the lights clothed in them. And what the ARI wrote nearby about the body of Adam HaRishon, that his Rosh is Beria, meaning Neshama and HBD, and his Guf, which is HGT, is Yetzira, meaning Ruach, and from the Chazeh downward is Assiya, meaning the light of Nefesh: this discernment is according to the values of the lights clothed in him. And likewise, from this discernment, the Rosh and the HGT down to the Chazeh are discerned as the discernment of the nine first Sefirot in the Guf, which are Keter and ABY, and from the Chazeh downward only as the Sefira of Malchut in it, called Assiya. For so it is from the discernment of the clothing of the lights in the vessels, since every revelation of an action in the vessels is only according to the lights clothed in them.
However, when we are concerned with discerning only the values of the vessels alone, as here in the matter of the Shabbat boundary, where the prohibition rests chiefly on the discernments of the places, which are the vessels, we must discern in them ten complete Sefirot: KHB ZON, called Rosh and ABYA, each of which emerges from the discernment corresponding to it in the upper roots, up to one higher than the high, by way of branch and root. Therefore this applies in a corporeal body too, as above.
And this is what he says: “When they reached the place of the sixth Sefira of the present Yetzira, He said to them, Enough, and do not expand and do not enter into the boundary of the fourteen Sefirot; rather, they shall remain a space for the shells.” For it was explained (page 1923, in the passage beginning “And six Sefirot”) at the end of the item that all these three worlds BYA were emanated from the Nukva of Atzilut, and even the world of Assiya came out from the Nukva of Atzilut, for her upper one, which is the world of Yetzira, was then the discernment of the actual Nukva of Atzilut; see there. Therefore even the world of Assiya could expand only as far as the Sium of the Chazeh of the present Yetzira, that is, only in the measure of the sixty-seven Sefirot that are the discernment of the Atzilut of BYA, as above. But from the Chazeh downward, where they are already the discernment of BYA on the side of the vessels too, they could not expand, because the force of the Sium of the line of Ein Sof, which was made in the Parsa beneath Atzilut, begins to reveal its dominion there, at the Chazeh of Yetzira, that is, after the Sium of the Rosh and Atzilut of BYA. Therefore the offspring of the Nukva of Atzilut cannot expand there, for the dominion of the Sium of the line of Ein Sof, which was made in the second restriction, leaves these fourteen Sefirot in the discernment of a vacant space. And this is what he says: “rather, they shall remain a space for the shells.” For just as in the first restriction this world was made into a vacant space, as written (in Part 1), so in the second restriction the Chazeh of Yetzira downward became a vacant space, for the force of the Sium of the Parsa beneath Atzilut begins to be revealed there.
And compare the matter to what is written about AA of Atzilut: this screen at the Peh of AA, which brings the Bina of AA outside the Rosh, has no manifestation at all at the place of its emergence, at his Peh, but only at the place of his Chazeh. This is why AVI, who stand from his Peh to his Chazeh, still have a Rosh and GAR [first three], and only YESHSUT, who stand from his Chazeh downward, remained, because of this screen, in the discernment of VAK [six ends] without a Rosh, as we elaborated on this in the previous parts. And likewise here, the force of the Sium in the Parsa beneath Atzilut is the discernment of the Peh of the Rosh with respect to BYA, and therefore it begins only at the Chazeh of BYA, from which downward a vacant space was made for the shells, as above.
